failures.statement: Crateroute's gross order value increased 3.1-fold from 2024 to 2025. (3.1x year-over-year growth)
failures.reason: The source supports 3.1x growth from 2024 to 2025, but labels the metric as revenue growth rather than explicitly stating gross order value growth.

failures.statement: Unknown: The 610 active borrowers do not establish repeat usage, cohort retention, borrower profitability, or customer concentration.
failures.reason: The source supports that 610 active borrowers do not establish repeat usage, cohort retention, and profitability, but it says loan profitability rather than borrower profitability and does not explicitly state customer concentration.

failures.statement: Reconstruction vérifiée par le moteur du fonds : le marché bottom-up est estimé à 18–90 M$, contre un TAM de 210 Md$ présenté dans le deck.
failures.reason: La source confirme les estimations de 18–90 M$ et le TAM de 210 Md$ présenté dans le deck, mais elle ne qualifie pas la reconstruction de « vérifiée par le moteur du fonds ».

failures.statement: The records identify 16 named logos, but all 16 are described as logo-only rather than independently verified customer evidence.
failures.reason: The source supports that 16 named logos are described as logo-only and company-only, but elsewhere refers to 18 named logos, so it does not consistently establish that there are exactly 16.

failures.statement: Économie unitaire — company-reported / calculée : ACV de $42k, CAC de $58k et CAC payback calculé de 22,4 mois.
failures.reason: The source states the ACV, CAC, and derived CAC payback values exactly, including the company-reported and derived qualifiers.

failures.statement: It excludes GPU inference costs, which are the core delivery cost and are currently covered by cloud credits through 2027.
failures.reason: The source supports that GPU inference costs are excluded and covered by cloud credits through 2027, but does not state that they are the core delivery cost.

failures.statement: Company-reported: GPU inference costs are covered by cloud credits through 2027; the reported margin therefore does not show the underlying cost of serving customers.
failures.reason: The source supports that GPU inference costs are covered by cloud credits through 2027 and that the reported 81% margin excludes those costs, but it does not state that the margin therefore fails to show the underlying cost of serving customers.

failures.statement: Company-reported: Lendquarry reports $48M of loan volume originated since launch in March 2023.
failures.reason: The source states $48M in loan volume for Lendquarry, but does not say it was originated since launch or that the launch occurred in March 2023.

failures.statement: Company-reported: Cash is $4.0M and net burn is $480k per month as of August 2026.
failures.reason: The source supports the cash and net burn amounts and date, but does not state that net burn is $480k per month.

failures.statement: Open audit issue: The reported 3.1× 2025 growth is also unauditable because monthly GMV, recognized revenue, active buyers, orders, churn, and acquisition source have not been provided under one consistent definition.
failures.reason: The source supports that the 3.1× growth is unauditable and requests consistent monthly metrics, but it does not state that those metrics have not been provided, nor does it explicitly call the issue an audit issue.

failures.statement: Derived: These figures imply 6.3 months of runway before the new financing, excluding hiring, transaction costs, burn increases, or working-capital needs.
failures.reason: The source supports a derived 6.3-month runway from cash and net burn, but does not state that it is specifically before the new financing or that hiring, transaction costs, burn increases, and working-capital needs are excluded.

failures.statement: The reported 5-of-11 pilot conversion, shown as 45% inferred, is not reconciled to the stated 27 paid pilots.
failures.reason: The source supports that the 5-of-11 figure is not reconciled to 27 paid pilots, but it does not state or infer the 45% calculation.

failures.statement: The $20M cap also needs to be evaluated against verified recurring revenue, because the current $624k ARR is derived from reported MRR rather than independently verified.
failures.reason: The source supports that the $624k ARR is derived from company-reported MRR, but it does not explicitly state that the $20M cap must be evaluated against independently verified recurring revenue.

failures.statement: Company-reported: Gross margin is 81% as of August 2026, explicitly excluding GPU inference costs.
failures.reason: The source supports an 81% gross margin excluding GPU inference costs, but it does not explicitly date the gross margin figure to August 2026.

failures.statement: Company-reported: Page 4 defines the same $8.2M as “gross order value through the platform,” with an 11% take rate.
failures.reason: The source supports the $8.2M gross order value through the platform and the 11% take rate, but it does not establish that this appears on Page 4.
